chunks: Al-Ḥalabī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who forgot to say the takbīr until he had entered into the salat (prayer).
So he said, “Was it not in his intention to say the takbīr?” He said, “Yes.” He said, “Then let him continue in his salat (prayer).”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbdillāh, Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحَلَبِيُّ: Al-Ḥalabī, the narrator asking the Imam عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgot the opening takbīr in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgot the opening takbīr after entering the salat (prayer). If the intention to say the takbīr was present, the Imam عليه السلام instructs that the person should continue the prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.999 - The Halabi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man who forgot to say the Takbir (the opening Takbir) until he had entered the prayer.

Imam (as) said: "Was it not in his intention to say the Takbir?"
He replied: "Yes."
Imam (as) said: "Then let him continue with his prayer."
